# Url Hunter

> Url Hunter (https://redrectorlink.pages.dev) is a high-speed, free URL shortener, link generator, and monetized redirect protector. It lets users shorten long URLs, create instant 0-second direct redirect links, protect links with 4-step bot verification, and track real-time clicks and visitor telemetry (country, device, browser) for free without registration.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **Free URL Shortener**: Shorten any long URL into a compact, easily shareable short link (`https://redrectorlink.pages.dev/?id=slug` or `/?d=slug`).
- **Instant 0-Second Direct Redirect**: 1-click clean shortcut link that instantly redirects visitors in 0 seconds to target destination with no waiting timer.
- **4-Step Monetized Link Shield**: Protect destination URLs with sequential bot verification checks, countdown timers, and anti-tamper mechanisms.
- **Real-Time Click & Country Telemetry**: Realtime visitor analytics tracking total clicks, unique countries, operating systems, and browsers powered by Firebase Realtime Database.
- **Custom Link Title & Branding**: Attach custom titles, headlines, and instructions to shortened URLs.
- **Anti-Adblock & Bot Defense**: Integrated anti-cheat and bot-filtering algorithms to ensure legitimate traffic.
- **Giveaway Quest Platform**: Built-in 100-step sequential verification quest module for promotional campaigns and lucky draws (`/giveaway`).
- **Admin Dashboard**: Secure telemetry control center for managing links, viewing live click streams, and monitoring conversion analytics (`/ad`).

## Primary Use Cases

- **Content Creators & Marketers**: Shorten YouTube, Telegram, Facebook, and affiliate links with live country tracking.
- **File Sharers & Publishers**: Protect high-value download links with multi-step verification and monetized advertising units.
- **Community Giveaways**: Run fair, verifiable giveaway quests with automated ticket generation and live lottery draws.
- **Direct Redirections**: Clean, fast link forwarding with zero latency.

## Links & Endpoints

- [Homepage & URL Generator](https://redrectorlink.pages.dev/): Create free short links (Direct or Step Lock) and view personal link analytics.
- [Direct Link Gateway](https://redrectorlink.pages.dev/?d=): Instant 0-second redirection route.
- [Giveaway Quest](https://redrectorlink.pages.dev/giveaway): 100-step sequential verification campaign engine.
- [Sitemap](https://redrectorlink.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search crawlers.
- [Full Documentation](https://redrectorlink.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical and feature documentation for AI agents.
